title: Set up a Node project
description: Use when bootstrapping a Node.js project: npm init, install a dependency, run the tests.
overview: Initialises package.json, installs express while the install output streams by, and runs npm test.

steps.actions: Run `npm init -y` to accept every default.
steps.success_criteria: package.json is written and echoed back.
npm reports the packages it added.

evidence.quote: npm install express adds the web framework

steps.success_criteria: Every test reports ok and the summary says fail 0.

evidence.quote: npm test runs the test suite
